paragraphs: We are deeply grateful for your love, prayers, and presence. Your duas and warm wishes have enriched this journey with immense joy and barakah.
As we begin this new chapter together, we humbly ask Allah SWT to bless our marriage with love, patience, mercy, and everlasting happiness.
May He guide us in every step, fill our home with peace, and grant us a bond rooted in faith, understanding, and gratitude.
